current_state: 604 roles were loaded in the inspected live snapshot; breadth is already ample, but recent runs and inventory counts disagree
competitive_context: LinkedIn, Indeed, Jobright, Simplify, Teal, and aggregators exceed or match breadth and distribution
verdict: Do not compete on inventory volume
next_move: Optimize for 3-5 decision-worthy roles per week and make run accounting truthful

current_state: Official/ATS links, verification, suppression, identities, and safe-apply artifacts are substantive; source labels still collapse different evidence states
competitive_context: Most trackers capture a URL, while job agents own breadth; fewer publicly expose immutable source provenance
verdict: Promising wedge, not yet accepted end to end
next_move: Adopt one source-state ladder and one versioned search receipt

current_state: 405 roles showed full postings, and materials block incomplete sources; code uses multiple thresholds for what full means
competitive_context: Competitors often store descriptions, but public evidence of immutable full-posting snapshots and change lineage is limited
verdict: Differentiated only if definitions and change invalidation are exact
next_move: Define one material-ready contract with timestamp, hash, parsed sections, freshness, and semantic diff

current_state: Aliases, conflict handling, suppression, duplicate, unchanged, and changed states show strong intent
competitive_context: General trackers and job boards have large identity graphs but rarely make candidate-visible provenance central
verdict: Technically strong but operational proof is incomplete
next_move: Prove reconciliation and restore across reload and future refresh

current_state: Compensation, location, scope, company, and upside are separated from qualification
competitive_context: Jobright, LinkedIn, Levels.fyi, executive networks, and human advisors already provide pieces of opportunity intelligence
verdict: Useful but labels currently overstate precision
next_move: Expose score version, confidence, factors, and separate pursuit recommendation

current_state: Requirement-level evidence exists, but the browser can synthesize exact fallback values and reuse one score across dimensions
competitive_context: Teal, Jobscan, Huntr, Careerflow, and many resume tools provide matching and gaps
verdict: Currently less trustworthy than the strongest commodity match tools
next_move: Remove browser fallback; show not scored and requirement-level evidence confidence

current_state: Base versus package/OTE, equity, geography, missing pay, and relocation tradeoffs are modeled explicitly
competitive_context: Market products offer salary filters and benchmarks; few candidate tools publicly combine compensation confidence and relocation decision logic
verdict: Real executive differentiation if calibrated and explainable
next_move: Show source/confidence/range logic and validate decisions with paid users

current_state: 40 facts and three lanes feed scoring and writing, but the UI is a flat list and direct-route hydration omits lanes
competitive_context: Generic AI projects, Notion, and resume master profiles can approximate a knowledge base; few career products publicly govern claim variants and uses
verdict: Potential core moat, current UX does not earn it
next_move: Use explicit approved allowlist, fix hydration, and ship evidence cards with source excerpts and usage lineage

current_state: Evidence-safe generation and parser review exist; the audited OpenAI v6 resume was factual but scored 73/100 and was a cold-apply no-go
competitive_context: Jobscan, Rezi, Teal, Resume Worded, Careerflow, and many low-cost tools are mature here
verdict: Commoditized unless claim lineage and channel strategy are exceptional
next_move: Separate factual integrity from role coverage and cold-application readiness

current_state: Distinct resume concepts exist, but current proof does not show consistent executive-level narrative superiority
competitive_context: Korn Ferry, outplacement firms, executive coaches, and specialist writers can exceed generic AI editorial judgment
verdict: Unproven commercial quality
next_move: Run blinded advisor comparisons by channel and role family

current_state: The product can recommend next actions, but writing still precedes an explicit channel decision in the default mental model
competitive_context: Human coaches and executive networks are stronger at deciding recruiter, warm intro, cold ATS, search firm, or pass
verdict: Missing orchestration layer
next_move: Choose pursuit channel before generation and treat do-not-cold-apply as a successful outcome

current_state: Role-scoped outreach assets exist and no automatic send is allowed
competitive_context: LinkedIn, Teal, Simplify, WonsultingAI, CRM products, and coaches cover outreach well
verdict: Table stakes; trust boundary is more valuable than output volume
next_move: Generate only channel-relevant outreach and preserve manual employer action

current_state: Revisions and reusable guidance exist, but rule promotion needs scope, provenance, conflict handling, and review dates
competitive_context: General AI projects and writing products can retain preferences cheaply
verdict: Not a moat without governed learning
next_move: Make every promoted rule explicit, scoped, reversible, and attributable

current_state: Versions exist, but comparison is full side-by-side text and numbering/persistence are client-calculated
competitive_context: Teal, Huntr, document tools, and general versioning products cover basic history
verdict: Below the standard needed for high-stakes approvals
next_move: Use server-allocated immutable versions and semantic claim/evidence diffs

current_state: Manual approvals and approved exports exist; approvals do not yet prove an exact signed source/Canon/content snapshot
competitive_context: Jobscan and several automation tools now provide approval-first steps
verdict: Strong brand boundary, incomplete technical guarantee
next_move: Sign posting, brief, Canon, content, model, and review hashes and invalidate stale approvals

current_state: One honest live record exists, but only eight rows load and legitimate statuses can disappear from both columns
competitive_context: Teal, Huntr, Simplify, Careerflow, and general CRMs are substantially more mature
verdict: P0 product defect, not differentiation
next_move: Centralize stages, paginate with totals, render every record exactly once, and add a pursuit timeline

current_state: Preparation assets exist but the current system is not a specialist interview practice platform
competitive_context: Final Round AI, Big Interview, Huru, interviewing.io, Exponent, and coaches exceed it in practice depth
verdict: Partial adjacency
next_move: Focus on evidence-grounded executive stories and decision questions, not generic mock-interview breadth

current_state: Role briefs, economics, gaps, next actions, and controlled materials form a coherent decision system; hidden rank weights and conflicting labels weaken it
competitive_context: No public reviewed product evidenced the identical integrated stack, but human advisors and DIY AI stacks can substitute
verdict: Best commercial wedge if trust semantics become exceptional
next_move: Rename Best to Curated review order and make every recommendation explainable

current_state: Deterministic checks pass, but the July audit records duplicate paid Writer calls and no accepted end-to-end role kit
competitive_context: Enterprise workflow products provide stronger idempotency, tenancy, and audit guarantees
verdict: Commercial blocker
next_move: Implement atomic server-side claims, bounded retries, unique outputs/approvals, and concurrency acceptance tests

current_state: Single-user access and no automatic employer actions are good; tenant isolation, export, deletion, and provider governance are not commercially proven
competitive_context: Executive outplacement and enterprise vendors sell trust, contracts, controls, and support
verdict: No-go for external candidate data
next_move: Prove real second-account denial, row isolation, portable export, deletion, retention, and provider registry

current_state: The integrated product is credible as founder-led decision infrastructure, not yet as self-serve SaaS
competitive_context: Commodity career AI anchors price low; coaches and outplacement anchor high-touch value high
verdict: Start as a tightly bounded tech-enabled service
next_move: After P0 gates, test one 12-week concierge Search Pass with at most five users and record all human/model cost
